technical-summary: Add descriptor-discovered standalone MCP wheel extraction with conservative Python/configured-hook dependency closure, canonical resource copying, SHA256 manifests, public per-server stdio console scripts and isolated wheel validation. All consumers use separate virtual environments; full application distribution is absent. Add extraction regression tests and document the broad shared-runtime coupling tracked separately.
user-summary-candidate: Build and test standalone MCP bundles without shipping a repository checkout; planning and ledger support isolated functional round trips. Minimal co-installable component packages remain separate follow-up work.
